verdict.rationale: Blocking senders' tracking pixels and being transparent about mail data are fair questions for an email client like Outlook, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack covers remote-image or pixel blocking, default tracking protection, or a data-use transparency disclosure. The docs cover Graph mail APIs, and the community items discuss link handling, performance and ads, none of which bear on this story.

support.subject: As a switcher, the client protects me from senders' tracking — blocking read pixels by default — and is transparent about what it does with my mail data
